title: Presenilin homologues influence substrate binding and processing by γ-secretase: a molecular simulation study
authors: Melissa K Eccles; David Groth; Giuseppe Verdile; Mark Agostino
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子模拟探讨γ-分泌酶同源物对底物结合与加工的影响，但对象为膜蛋白酶-底物互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Presenilin homologues in the γ-secretase complex play a pivotal role in substrate binding and processing, impacting β-amyloid (Aβ) peptide generation in Alzheimer’s disease. We conducted a molecular simulation study to determine substrate preferences between presenilin-1 (PS1) and presenilin-2 (PS2) γ-secretase enzymes for amyloid precursor protein (APP) and Notch1 processing. Using homology modelling, we generated PS1- and PS2-γ-secretase models bound to substrates in the Aβ40 and Aβ42 generation pathways and Notch1 S3 and S4 cleavage site substrates. Metadynamics simulations and binding free energy calculations were used to explore conformational ensembles and substrate preferences. PS2-γ-secretase exhibited increased conformational flexibility and preferential binding energy for initiating the Aβ42 pathway compared to PS1-γ-secretase. Additionally, Notch1 exhibits a preference for binding to PS2-γ-secretase over PS1-γ-secretase. This study provides valuable insights into the conformational dynamics of γ-secretase bound to different substrates within a cleavage pathway, improving our understanding of substrate processivity. The findings highlight the importance of considering both PS1- and PS2-γ-secretase in structure-based drug design efforts, with implications for stabilizing or destabilizing specific states during APP processing.
abstract_zh: γ-分泌酶复合物中的早老素同源物在底物结合和加工中发挥关键作用，影响阿尔茨海默病中β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）肽的生成。我们进行了一项分子模拟研究，以确定早老素-1（PS1）和早老素-2（PS2）γ-分泌酶对淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）和Notch1加工的底物偏好。通过同源建模，我们生成了PS1-和PS2-γ-分泌酶模型，这些模型与Aβ40和Aβ42生成途径中的底物以及Notch1 S3和S4切割位点底物结合。使用元动力学模拟和结合自由能计算来探索构象系综和底物偏好。与PS1-γ-分泌酶相比，PS2-γ-分泌酶在启动Aβ42途径时表现出更高的构象灵活性和优先结合能。此外，Notch1对PS2-γ-分泌酶的结合偏好高于PS1-γ-分泌酶。本研究为γ-分泌酶在切割途径中与不同底物结合的构象动态提供了宝贵见解，增进了我们对底物加工连续性的理解。研究结果强调了在基于结构的药物设计工作中考虑PS1-和PS2-γ-分泌酶的重要性，并对APP加工过程中特定状态的稳定或去稳定具有启示意义。
